mentions.name: webfrolic
mentions.description: An identity, security and access platform architected to combine workforce identity (Okta-like), customer identity (Auth0-like), fine-grained authorization (Authzed-like), an IT service desk (ServiceNow-like), and a customer support desk (Zendesk-like). Work in progress: deciding how to incorporate AI agents' needs into the architecture while avoiding security and performance foot guns from administrator configuration, plus feature stress testing and performance testing.
mentions.problem: Challenges and gaps between specs vs implementation and asks vs real needs in the space of identity, security and access.

Product:  webfrolic.com
